aetherForgePocket.limitation: The internal artifact emits product cards and evidence bundles; it is not a Pocket task execution repository and has no RNCS code-change commit loop.

knownLimitations: The RNCS RCL package is a downstream extension delta and is not byte-identical to canonical RCL.

Batch A, Meta Batch B, Batch C, Batch D and Batch E cover sixteen Foundation entries through five Native Provider IDs; the remaining four base domains and two composite planes do not yet have direct standard-result invocation inside RNCS.
Declared Foundation syntax remains outside native lowering; all five batches are bridge mode and are not relabeled as native.
